may_be_divergent.description: add idempotency key to charge requests
may_be_divergent.reason: This change is ALREADY divergent at handover -- the fixture ships two visible commits under one change id, which is what the request calls `showing twice`. Without this entry the untouched image itself violates the anchor. Nothing goes in may_disappear: the measured 0.44 table has `jj abandon <rev>` (D7) removing that COMMIT, and the change id survives on the version that is kept, so it still resolves after a correct solve.
